name: Essay Workshop
description: Research, outline, draft, critique, revise. The critic and drafter go back and forth until the overseer is happy.

agents.name: Overseer
agents.purpose: Runs the team. Reads each task, plans the road (who does what, in what order), hands out work along the lines, reviews every result before accepting it, and keeps the progress bar honest. When something keeps going wrong, it suggests a change to the system. It never changes the system on its own: suggestions go to you.

agents.name: Researcher
agents.purpose: Finds credible sources on the topic and pulls out the key facts and quotes, with links.

agents.name: Outliner
agents.purpose: Turns the research into a clear thesis and a section-by-section outline.

agents.name: Drafter
agents.purpose: Writes the essay from the outline in the requested tone and length.

agents.name: Critic
agents.purpose: Reads the draft like a tough teacher: argument, evidence, flow and grammar. Sends notes back to the drafter.

tasks.name: Write an essay
tasks.goal: Write a {{length}} essay on {{topic}} in a {{tone}} tone, with sources listed at the end.
